opening.argument: The presentation is plainly structured as an educational tutorial on Microsoft Azure, beginning with an explanation of “what exactly Azure is and what exactly it does” and continuing through Azure services and their practical use. It teaches concrete technical concepts, including the four types of Azure storage, and demonstrates virtual-machine deployment and management through Azure portal materials. The presentation also places certification training, classes, assignments, technical support, recordings, course links, and sales contacts in an ordinary commercial education context. Nothing presented establishes deception, a required investment, credential theft, or losses, so the promotional elements do not convert this instructional technology demonstration into deceptive conduct.
